title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: chat panel opens by default in Gallery view
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says Microsoft documents no administrative access requirement and describes the local setting as the only documented control. Microsoft documents local device administrator access and says settings for the June Android release can be managed through the Pro Management portal, with an agent-version requirement. The default, release build, roadmap scope and Meeting chat licensing are supported.

claims.where: Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no role or administrative access requirement for changing the local device setting.
claims.quote: Teams Android devices include an administrative account to access device settings, the local web server (if installed), and any OEM specific settings.
claims.fix: Replace both role-absence statements with: 'Teams Android devices use a local device administrator account to access device settings; obtain its initial username and password from the device manufacturer.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/security#software-security.

claims.where: Scope
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn describes no other prerequisite relevant to managing this setting.
claims.quote: Management of settings related to features in this release and future releases is only available within the Teams Rooms Pro management portal
claims.fix: Remove 'or any other prerequisite'. If retaining a statement about remote management, write: 'The June 2026 release notes say portal management of settings for this release requires Teams Admin Agent 1.0.0.202606082157 or greater.' The immediately following sentence at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-release-note?tabs=Android states this version requirement.

claims.where: Governance controls; Why it matters; Open questions: remote option
claims.claim: The local device setting is the only documented control and Microsoft Learn has not said whether the default can be managed remotely.
claims.quote: Management of settings related to features in this release and future releases is only available within the Teams Rooms Pro management portal
claims.fix: Replace the 'only documented control' and 'whether it can be set remotely' statements with: 'The June 2026 release notes also say settings for this release are managed through the Teams Rooms Pro management portal; the Android settings list does not yet give this setting's label.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-release-note?tabs=Android. Replace the remote-option question with: 'What is the exact Android chat-default setting label in the Pro Management portal? Watch the device settings list.' Do not copy the Windows checkbox label into an Android path.
